meta.title: Android Emulator Helper
meta.description: Unofficial helper for Google's Android Emulator: 23 native android_* tools covering SDK discovery, AVD and emulator lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose project scaffolding, Gradle build and run, install and launch, screenshots, logcat and UI automation, plus the SDK, emulator and build parameters on the plugin row's own page in the Plugins panel, and the same form in the Settings dialog once the Show in Settings switch is on. Not affiliated with Google.

settings.intro: Changes are saved to this profile and take effect on the next tool call.
settings.invalid: Enter a positive whole number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.writeBlocked: One value is invalid; fix it before saving
settings.writeFailed: These values were not accepted, so they are still staged.
settings.unavailable: This plugin's settings are not served, so it cannot be configured right now.
settings.formFailed: This form could not be loaded; the saved settings are unchanged.
settings.toolsHint: The diagnostic runs the same checks as android_preflight in the app. Discovery refreshes the suggestions offered by the fields above.
settings.rowSummary: SDK, emulator, system-image, build and output parameters for this plugin's tools.
settings.group.sdk.hint: The Android SDK and JDK the diagnostic, the build and sdkmanager use.
settings.field.sdkPath.hint: Empty falls back to ANDROID_HOME, ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, the registry, the project local.properties, then the common install paths on every drive.
settings.field.jdkMajor.hint: Used by the diagnostic and the install guidance; the suggestions come from this machine's JDKs.
settings.field.buildToolsVersion.hint: The Android SDK build-tools version pinned into a generated project; leave empty to let AGP choose.
settings.group.emulator.hint: The default AVD, how the emulator starts, and the arguments it receives.
settings.field.defaultAvd.hint: The dropdown lists the AVDs on this machine that still have their payload; preferred when an emulator must be started, falling back to the first available AVD.
settings.field.defaultSerial.hint: Empty prefers a ready emulator, then any ready device.
settings.field.autoStartEmulator.hint: When off, tools fail instead of starting an emulator when no device is ready.
settings.field.emulatorArgs.hint: One argument per line, and an option and its value each get their own line; `#` starts a comment. e.g. -no-snapshot-load, or -gpu and swiftshader_indirect on two lines.
settings.field.bootTimeoutSeconds.hint: Longest wait for the emulator to finish booting; 180 seconds by default.
settings.group.image.hint: Defaults used when generating a project, installing SDK packages and creating an AVD.
settings.field.apiLevel.hint: API level used when generating projects, installing SDK packages and picking a system image.
settings.field.systemImageAbi.hint: Automatic uses arm64-v8a on Apple Silicon and x86_64 elsewhere.
settings.field.minSdk.hint: Default minSdk for a project created by android_create_app; 23 by default.
settings.field.buildTimeoutSeconds.hint: Longest runtime of one assemble task; 600 seconds by default.
settings.field.gradleExtraArgs.hint: One argument per line; `#` starts a comment.
settings.group.output.hint: Where screenshots and build logs are written.
settings.field.dataDir.hint: Root for screenshots and build logs; empty uses $DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper.
settings.field.screenshotDir.hint: Empty uses `screenshots` under the data directory.
settings.field.logTailLines.hint: Lines android_logs reads when the call names none; 500 by default.
settings.group.interface.hint: How this settings page is shown in DeepSeek Harness.
settings.field.showInSettings.hint: When on and saved, this page also appears in the Settings dialog's navigation with a line-art Android icon; when off it appears only on the plugin row's own page in the Plugins panel, reached from that row rather than from the bundle's detail page.
